questions.question_text: Explain how Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) deplete the stratospheric ozone layer.
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: CFCs released into atmosphere rise to stratosphere where UV radiation splits free chlorine atoms. Chlorine acts as a catalyst breaking O3 molecules into O2.

questions.question_text: Why do food chains in nature generally contain only 3 to 4 trophic steps?
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: Because 90% of energy is lost at each transfer step, after 3 to 4 trophic levels the remaining energy pool is too small to sustain further consumer populations.
